The codebase has an inconsistency: some modules already use XDG-compliant paths via `dirs::cache_dir()` / `dirs::data_local_dir()`, but 5 locations still hardcode `~/.bivvy/` under the home directory. | Location | Current path | New path | `dirs` function |

| Failure reports | `~/.bivvy/failure-reports/` | `$XDG_DATA_HOME/bivvy/failure-reports/` | `dirs::data_local_dir()` |

- Linux: `~/.config/bivvy`, `~/.local/share/bivvy`
- macOS: `~/Library/Application Support/bivvy` for both config and data
- Windows: `%APPDATA%\bivvy`
